pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
Hostile boss summoned by the Sculk Shrine.

• HP: 300, Attack: 10 (melee)
• Speed: 0.3 (mimics Warden)
• Weak Regen I, full knockback resistance
• Immune to fire, lava, and all projectile damage

Attacks all non-Creative/non-Spectator mobs. Retaliates when hit.

pages.title: Sonic Boom Attack
pages.text:
When target is out of melee range, charges and fires a sonic boom:

• Damage: 6 (armor-piercing)
• Charge: 1.5s (audio cue plays)
• Cooldown: 7s
• Range: 32 blocks, pulls target toward boss

pages.title: Emergence & Drops
pages.text:
Rises from the Shrine over 5 seconds (smoke + soul fire particles). Invulnerable during animation. Roars when ready.

60% chance to drop a Warden Doll Head (+10% per Looting). Craft with 8 Sculk blocks for the Warden Doll Egg.
